faq: Which tools can you connect to Wix?

Common ones such as HubSpot, Mailchimp, Google Workspace, Calendly, Stripe, QuickBooks and Slack. If it has a Wix app, an API or a Zapier connection, we can usually link it. Name it in the order form.
Do I need to pay for Zapier or Make?
Only if the connection needs one, and then the subscription is yours. We use Wix's built-in Automations and apps wherever they are enough, and tell you any cost before we build.
Will my customers' data be safe?

We connect through official app or API routes, never ask for your passwords and only pass the fields each tool needs. Consent wording and privacy rules for your region are your decision, and we point out where they apply.
What happens if an app update breaks a link?
It can happen. We test at handover and leave a note on how each link works, so you or we can fix it fast. Ongoing monitoring is not part of this order, and we quote it separately.
